brief: A base with a bay bin in one half of its cell.

requirements.requirement: A base (structural block the rest hangs from)
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;half-e: a Hex base, East half, at cell 0,0,0 (replaced the original Full base, since a half-cell bin cannot sit in a Full cell).

requirements.requirement: A bin occupying one half of the base's cell
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half-e-full: 'Bin, east half, full depth', cut to the East half outline of the cell. check_build: meshClash clear, no rule errors (one info note about open cap faces).

requirements.requirement: Specifically a 'bay bin' (bay family notch tray)
requirements.evidence: Bay trays (family bay, e.g. hex-bin-bay-n-half-solid) stand in an empty spot touching three bases, so they need a three-cell arrangement. find_sockets for bay returned no offers on the single-base build, and I did not build the three-base arrangement. I substituted an East-half bin, which matches 'one half of its cell' but is not a bay tray.

finish.summary: Built a single East-half base with an East-half, full-depth bin filling that half of the cell. Mesh check is clear. I did not add a bay-family bin, because bay trays need an empty spot touching three bases and the brief's 'bay bin' may have meant that part. If so, the build needs two more bases around an empty spot.
